about: SPEC §1 merge: receiving `inc` for an id held as `cur`, the greater (u, o) wins; `o` compares as its wire string ("follower" < "mac" < "phone"). `wins` = which version every device keeps, whatever order the two arrive in (`same`: an equal (u, o) is the same version, the second one changes nothing). Read by Android SukraraDatabaseTest (Room) and TreatmentMergeTest (Treatment.supersedes, TreatmentPayload.newerThan, the in-memory store), Mac TreatmentTests (TreatmentMerge.winner, TreatmentLog) and AcceptanceRulesTests (TreatmentPayload.isNewer).

cases.name: newer u wins whatever the origin
equal u: follower loses to phone
equal u: mac loses to phone
the same version again changes nothing
